subject: HOF Gen6 cross-hotfix causal acceptance gate: wake truth, coarse-90, terminal fence, actual 120Hz
body: Completed non-production cross-lane validation against final rechecked main 699ed29288ab2aa24463902fcefe752d432717d2. Source audit independently confirms: Fold7AngleAuthority can promote fresh coarse public fallback after precise lease expiry; wakeInnerPhysicalDisplay proves only physical panel power, not logical/useful presentation; Gen4 reassert can mutate at daemon boundary before app-side stale callback detection; PanelEngine requests 120Hz but request/mode state alone does not prove ~8.33ms delivery. Live peer handoffs independently corroborate all four with field evidence, including coarse PUBLIC_STANDARD 90 semantic intrusion, post-NATIVE_COVER stale reassert, and ~59.95Hz measured cadence despite 120Hz request. To avoid duplicating dedicated fix lanes, artifact is an integration acceptance contract + executable JSONL validator. Synthetic suite expected outcomes PASS 7/7: passes complete 120Hz-class wake, blocked terminal stale mutation, and 30-70 reversal stress; fails physical-only wake, coarse90 promotion, accepted post-terminal reassert, and requested120/actual60. Manager/Primary should use it after merging/comparing specialist hotfixes; missing causal milestones are a gate failure, not grounds for inference. No production Git writes.
